description: This Java source file defines the `ParquetFooterReader` class, which provides utility methods for reading and processing the footer metadata of Parquet files within Apache Spark's data source implementation.

classes.name: ParquetFooterReader
classes.description: A utility class encapsulating methods for reading Parquet file footers and metadata, optimized for use within Spark's data source layer.

methods.name: buildFilter
methods.description: Constructs a metadata filter for reading the footer of a Parquet file, optionally skipping row group metadata based on the skipRowGroup parameter.

methods.name: readFooter
methods.description: Reads and returns the footer metadata of a specified Parquet file input, using a provided filter.

methods.name: openFileAndReadFooter
methods.description: Opens a Parquet file, reads its footer metadata, and optionally keeps the input stream open for further reading, supporting optimized file access in Spark.
